answer: Each identity claims one distributary of a canyon river, locking 70 credits. Each claimant must carry 40 flow units at 2 credits per unit, and a prism splitter fixes its published share. The board publishes inflow and all outflows, so anyone can recompute the sum: inflow must equal total outflow, and a unit counted twice burns both bonds. The kth fake cannot reuse counted water, so it still pays 70 plus 80: 1000 fakes lock 70000 and pay 80000. A flow-recycling ring fails because double-counted water breaks the sum. An honest claimant pays 150 once and recovers 70 if clean.
